status: implemented; iPhone/iPad functional and final render acceptance passed; Mac walkthrough pending unlock

contract.monthly_dates: daysOfMonth: unique integer array, 1...31, monthly only; mutually exclusive with single-day, ordinal and other calendar selectors.
contract.planned_rhythm: Visit remaining selected dates in the current active month, then advance the chosen month interval; late completion skips missed dates while retaining active-month alignment.
contract.from_completion: Wait the full month interval from completion, then find the first selected calendar date on or after that boundary.
contract.short_months: Clamp requested dates independently to month end and emit once per actual day, preserving original requested dates for later months.
contract.limits: Remaining occurrence count includes the current task; inclusive end date. Checklist items retain the existing parent occurrence behavior.
contract.preview: Up to five next dates; first assumes completion today, subsequent ones assume completion on the displayed day; source Gregorian zone; no mutation.
contract.quick_capture: Whole comma/and lists with existing start/end/count clauses. Invalid or duplicate lists remain literal.
contract.preservation: Opaque rule metadata, saved date set, source clock/zone, stable successor identity, queues and supported backups preserved.
